title: أنقليزية
notes: WORKBOOK: Proceed with English, 9th Year, Activity Book, the companion to the main Student's Book 141906. It mirrors the Student's Book: 6 modules with 5 lessons each, and the same module map on p6. Lesson titles come from the module 1 map and the running heads. 12 lessons use positional labels 'Lesson N': M2 L3; M3 L3-5; M4 L5; M5 L1-3 and L5; M6 L2, L4, L5. Four titles not seen in this book's extract are taken from the Student's Book 141906: Smoking and health, Internet shopping, Transport, How to be cooperative. 'Clubs, associations and charities' (p178, M6) appears only in a proverb/riddle box and was not used as a lesson title. Grandma's corner stories, word lists, projects, proverbs, riddles and tests were excluded.
